name: Family Joining Visa

requirements.blocker_text: The sponsor must be an expatriate employee in a senior position (per GCC standards).
The sponsor's monthly salary must be at least OMR 600.
Housing must be rented under the sponsor's name or their employer's name.
Available to the sponsor's spouse and children under 21.

requirement_groups.name: Foreign wife of an Omani citizen

requirements.blocker_text: A foreign wife of an Omani citizen may be sponsored on the husband's request, with an authenticated marriage certificate and Ministry of Interior approval of the marriage.

evidence_required.document: Housing/tenancy contract in sponsor's or employer's name
For foreign wives of Omani citizens: authenticated marriage certificate and Ministry of Interior marriage approval

outcome.duration_length: 2 years, multi-entry, renewable while sponsor's status continues

sources.title: Royal Oman Police -- Family Joining Visa: senior expatriate employee sponsorship, OMR 600/month minimum sponsor salary, housing requirement, spouse and under-21 children eligible, 2-year multi-entry visa; separate route for foreign wives of Omani citizens with Ministry of Interior marriage approval

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Oman). The 'senior position per GCC standards' sponsor-seniority requirement is quoted directly from ROP but not itself numerically defined on the fetched page -- disclosed as a soft/undefined threshold layered on top of the clear OMR 600 salary figure, rather than resolved into an invented job-title list. The foreign-wife-of-an-Omani-citizen route is gendered on its face (an Omani wife's foreign husband is not mentioned as a comparable sponsor category on this page) -- modeled precisely rather than assumed symmetric, consistent with this dataset's practice for Oman's other family/citizenship provisions (see om_citizenship_by_marriage.json). citizenship_after_months (240) reuses om_naturalisation.json's general 20-year figure since no family-specific reduced track to citizenship (short of the dedicated marriage-based citizenship route in om_citizenship_by_marriage.json) was found.
